context: A year after Hiroshi-elder's passing. Yumiko and Naoko sit together quietly.
purpose: one-year mark grief — two women reflecting on shared loss

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.en: A year's already gone by, hasn't it.
lines.style: Soft opening, almost to herself. Warm nostalgia without performance. Gentle pace, breath carries the weight of time. Trails slightly at the end — not a question, but an acknowledgment shared aloud.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん…早かった。けど、長かった。
lines.en: Yeah… it went fast. But it felt long.
lines.style: Quiet agreement, then the paradox settles in. Pause before 'long' — she's feeling it fresh. Soft, honest voice. No lifting at the end, just the truth sitting there.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: お父さん、毎日のように、思い出すわ。
lines.en: Your father — I remember him almost every day.
lines.style: Speaking into the shared grief with steadiness. Slight emphasis on 'every day' — not heavy-handed, just the fact of it. Voice stays low and even. This is something she knows to be true.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 私も。声、まだ、聞こえる気がする。
lines.en: Me too. I can still hear his voice sometimes.
lines.style: Vulnerable admission, delivered with quiet certainty. The word 'voice' catches slightly — not breaking, but tender. Soft and intimate, like speaking to someone who already understands.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: お父さん、私たちのこと、いつも見てくれてる気がする。
lines.en: I feel like he's always watching over us.
lines.style: Gentle conviction without sentimentality. Said as a simple fact, not wishful thinking. Calm, steady tone. A small comfort offered without forcing it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: メイちゃんの結婚式も、ちゃんと見てくれたよね。
lines.en: He was there at Mei-chan's wedding too — I'm sure of it.
lines.style: Warmth in the memory itself. Voice brightens slightly on 'wedding.' Speaking with the certainty of someone who felt his presence. Pace stays unhurried, reflective.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 形見の指輪、メイちゃんがしてくれてた。お父さん、絶対嬉しかった。
lines.en: Mei wore the ring he left us. He would have been so happy.
lines.style: Tenderness and quiet pride in one breath. Voice softens on 'ring.' The certainty is gentle, not insistent. Small trailing warmth at the end, like holding onto the image.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 寂しいのは、ずっと、変わらないかもしれない。
lines.en: The loneliness might not ever go away, though.
lines.style: Honest and accepting, not despairing. Quiet philosophical tone. Slight pause after 'loneliness.' She's not fighting the feeling, just naming it. Exhale carries the weight.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: うん。でも、こうやって、姉妹で話せるのは、本当に救い。
lines.en: But being able to talk like this, just us sisters — that's a real gift.
lines.style: Gratitude surfaces without brightness. Voice steadies on 'gift.' Recognizing what they have in each other. Warm but grounded, not overselling the comfort.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お母さんも、ちゃんと、見守ってくれてる。
lines.en: Your mother's watching over us too, keeping us safe.
lines.style: Soft certainty again. Voice carries affection for the absent mother. Not a statement of faith but of felt presence. Calm, protective tone. Slight pause before 'safe.'

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 家族、皆で、ずっと、繋がっていけたら、ね。
lines.en: I hope we can all stay connected like this, always.
lines.style: A wish spoken gently into the air. Not demanding, not urgent — just hopeful. Voice opens slightly on 'always.' Quiet desire to hold the family together across time.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さん、本当に、ありがとう。
lines.style: A prayer disguised as thanks. Each word deliberate and weighted. Long pause before this line — silence honoring what's being said. Quiet, reverent close.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: うん。お父さん、本当にありがとう。
lines.style: Echo and affirmation. Her sister's prayer becomes hers. Voice matches the reverence without mimicking. Same deliberate pace. Shared silence folded into the close.
